resources.string: The proxy core is not installed on this TV.
The core is a separate program (mihomo, GPLv3). It is downloaded only when you ask, and used only if its SHA-256 matches the value pinned in Aerial.
The download did not finish. Try again later; it continues from what was received.
The downloaded file did not match its pinned checksum and was deleted.
The TV has no room or cannot write the file; the core was not saved.
This TV does not let an app run a program it downloaded itself; the core was deleted.
The core did not run after the download and was deleted.
